posts.community: Embassy REIT: Is this "Blackstone" promoted REIT is real diamond?
posts.text: I am not expert and my view shall be considered as layman view. I feel AI distruption, how is unfold is very difficult to say. We would see the journey as it unfold and I see office real estate would be among the last assets class to be impacted. The recent decline in US office market demand, I feel mainly due to shift in lower manpower cost countries like India. In fact, the real adverse factor in my view would be shifting of office demand African/other Asian countries with lower manpower cost.
